title: Why things changed lives in Git
statement: The Saga records the current state, not the work of getting there; the reason for a change is recovered from Git, and compare mode surfaces it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When a slide, design, or test case drops out and another takes its place, compare mode shows them as a pair, inferred from the graph; the author links them explicitly only when that inference is ambiguous.
The commit messages in a comparison are attached to the nodes whose records or referenced code each commit touched, not listed as a flat log.
In observe mode a node shows when it was introduced and what it replaced, read from Git's log of its record files, with one step to open the comparison where it happened.
When references are re-pinned at merge, the branch's commit messages are recorded with the change so a squash merge keeps the finer reasoning.
